request_payload.title: CLN2 Disease (Classic Late Infantile Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis).

mentions.sentence: CLN2 disease is an inherited metabolic storage disorder caused by the deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme tripeptidyl peptidase 1 (TPP1).
